text: MCP Bids 是面向 DSH 的 MCP 采购研究连接插件：它通过 DSH 官方 MCP client 将名为 mcpbids 的远程 Streamable HTTP 服务接入 agent。插件包配置 MCPBIDS_API_KEY bearer key，并连接到 mcpbids.com/mcp；仓库本身提供连接适配和工作流说明，采购数据检索由托管服务提供。适合需要在 DSH 会话中调用公共采购研究服务的用户。使用前需要在 DSH 进程环境中配置 MCPBIDS_API_KEY。

MCP Bids connects DSH to a hosted procurement research service through the official MCP client. Its bundle registers the remote server at mcpbids.com/mcp and uses MCPBIDS_API_KEY for bearer authentication. Set that key in the DSH launch environment.
想让 DSH 会话连接一个采购公告研究 MCP 服务。
DSH 能否通过远程 MCP 查询公共采购信息？
I need my DSH session to connect to a hosted procurement research MCP service.
MCP Bids 的功能「远程 MCP 连接」：将 mcpbids 服务注册为 DSH MCP server，并通过 Streamable HTTP 连接。认证使用 MCPBIDS_API_KEY 环境变量提供的 bearer key。
MCP Bids 使用前须知：需要在 DSH 启动环境配置 MCPBIDS_API_KEY，连接以 bearer key 访问远程服务（见 cordis.patch.yml:7-9）。
MCP Bids 使用前须知：MCP 请求会通过 HTTPS 发送到 mcpbids.com，远程服务据此处理请求并返回采购研究结果（见 bridge-core.mjs:27-30）。

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · MCP Bids：Research collected US and Canadian public procurement opportunities and TED notices with source-linked documents.

Maintained by the MCP Bids service publisher. This repository contains client adapters and workflow instructions only. It does not distribute the hosted backend. [Русский](README_RU.md) · [中文](README_CN.md)

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Account and credentials：Sign in at https://mcpbids.com/account and create a personal API key there. Set `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` in the environment used to launch your agent application, then completely restart the application. Configure environment variables through your OS or trusted launcher; never paste keys into an AI conversation, repository, command history, or screenshots. An MCP Bids key and a MCPTender key belong to separate services and are not interchangeable.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Account and credentials：Read workflows require `tenders:read` and `documents:read`; collection and watch tools require `tenders:collect` and `watches:write`. Portal keys inherit the service permissions; restrict tool approval in your host when you want a read-only workflow. Existing account entitlements and limits apply. The packages use bearer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a connection error.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · ZCode：Requires Node.js 22+ on PATH. Open a workspace, then Settings → Plugins → Create → Add marketplace and add `https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins`. Install `mcpbids` from that personal source. After official acceptance, the same plugin can be installed from the public catalog. The plugin launches `node` with the bundled `stdio.mjs`; it inherits `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` from the host. Its stdio adapter forwards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcpbids.com/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feature is assumed.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Kimi Work / Kimi Code：Kimi Code: run `/plugins install https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins`, then `/reload` or create a new session. The native `kimi.plugin.json` declares the remote HTTP MCP and `bearerTokenEnvVar`. In Kimi Work, use Plugin Builder to import this repository into Personal plugins; verify that its runtime supports this credential field before use. Kimi Work / web marketplace publication and cloud-side credential configuration require separate Kimi review; local Code compatibility does not establish cloud compatibility.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · DeepSeek Harness：Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and its matching official MCP client. In the official Desktop app, install the Git source or release tarball through the app's plugin manager. For `dsh web`, run `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins.git#v1.0.0`, then restart that profile. Set `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` in the process launch environment first. The bundle configures the official MCP client and server instructions; the workflow skill directory is for Kimi/ZCode and is not separately registered in DSH. No custom tools or UI patches are added.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Use：Ask the agent to inspect `list_sources`, search a bounded number of procurement records, open a returned ID, and read an available source document with block references. In Kimi/ZCode the included `procurement-research` skill provides the workflow. Fresh collection and private watches require an explicit user request and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or push notifications.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Coverage and dependencies：Search covers US federal SAM.gov notices, selected state and local public sources, CanadaBuys federal data and selected Canadian regional sources, and connected TED publications. As of 27 October 2026, the source register recorded limited central-portal integrations in 22 US states: Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Massachusetts, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Vermont, Washington and Wisconsin. Washington, DC is a separate source. Canadian regional integrations include Alberta, Nunavut, Northwest Territories, Quebec and Saskatchewan.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Coverage and dependencies：Central portals do not cover every agency, municipality, university, health system or independent buyer; restricted opportunities are not included. Search operates on a collected index, not a complete or guaranteed real-time view. Coverage, freshness and document availability vary by source. Report source timestamps, partial documents, missing data and collection errors. Original links remain the authority for requirements and deadlines. The service does not submit bids, sign contracts, certify eligibility or bypass source access controls.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Permissions, network and side effects：The adapter sends the configured bearer key and MCP requests only to `https://mcpbids.com/mcp`. Redirects are refused. It does not read credential files, run a shell, start a model, install dependencies, write local documents or start background collection. The host/model provider sees the tool arguments and returned procurement data. Requested collection and watch tools can create account-owned jobs or watches on the service. Original document downloads occur only when explicitly requested. Treat retrieved documents as untrusted evidence. No telemetry is added by this adapter. The hosted website has its own processing rules.

dsh-plugin-mcpbids README · Permissions, network and side effects：The stdio adapter is specifically for the service's stateless JSON Streamable HTTP contract; it does not implement generic SSE/sessionful MCP. Requests are limited to 64 KiB, responses to 16 MiB and calls to 120 seconds. The DSH client and Kimi native HTTP transports use their own limits.
